$comment: Operations whose feature scenario is followed by a second identical call expecting 409 (the planner's duplicatePolicy 'conflict' replay, switched on here because the Hub spec carries no x-operation-kind). Each needs the repeat to be a real conflict: the reason says why. sequences: operations run between the target's own setup chain and the target, to leave the target in a state that conflicts (verified live against camunda/hub:SNAPSHOT, which answers 409 for each). untested: operations that document a 409 but have no conflict test yet, each with the tracking issue that says why; the Hub invariant requires every documented 409 to be tested or listed here.

replay.reason: A second review request for the same snapshot returns 409 ('A review request for the same process application version already exists'); verified live against camunda/hub:SNAPSHOT.

The replayed PATCH reuses the revision captured at create time. The first call renames the file so it really changes state and bumps the revision (an update that changes nothing keeps it), which makes the replay stale: 409. Verified live against camunda/hub:SNAPSHOT.
